title: Open pieces of an embedded submanifold are embedded submanifolds with the same tangent spaces (parent fact F2)
statement: Open pieces of embedded submanifolds. Data: P, r, d ∈ ℕ; N, O ⊆ ℝ^P. Hypotheses: N is an embedded C^r d-dimensional submanifold of ℝ^P (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r d N: every y ∈ N has open V ⊆ ℝ^d, open W ⊆ ℝ^P with y ∈ W, and ψ : ℝ^d → ℝ^P that is C^r on V and injective on V, with ψ(V) = W ∩ N, V ∩ ψ⁻¹(K) compact for every compact K ⊆ W, and Dψ(z) injective for every z ∈ V); O is open. Conclusion: (a) N ∩ O is an embedded C^r d-dimensional submanifold (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r d (N ∩ O)); (b) for every w ∈ O, tangentSpace(N ∩ O, w) = tangentSpace(N, w), where tangentSpace(M, w) is the set of v such that some γ : ℝ → ℝ^P is C¹ on (−1, 1), maps (−1, 1) into M, has γ(0) = w and has derivative v at 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P r d : ℕ) (N O : Set (Euclid P)), IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r d N → IsOpen O → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r d (N ∩ O) ∧ ∀ w ∈ O, tangentSpace (N ∩ O) w = tangentSpace N w
